links.outcome: LLM F1 versus disease-specific traditional machine learning models for patient identification
links.effect: GPT-4 had near similar or better performance compared to disease-specific ML models (F1 ≥ 85%) on COPD, CKD, PBC; 4.23% higher F1 on PBC. ChatGPT and LLaMA3 lower than GPT-4.
links.quote: In patient identification, GPT-4 had near similar or better performance compared to the corresponding disease-specific Machine Learning models (F1-score ≥ 85%) on COPD, CKD, and PBC.

unlisted_practices: few-shot prompting versus zero-shot prompting for LLM patient identification (higher precision/specificity but lower sensitivity/NPV)

screen.reason: Evaluates LLMs (ChatGPT, GPT-4, LLaMA) on a retrospective EHR dataset (MIMIC-III) for disease/patient identification, comparing base model outputs and few-shot prompting accuracy without testing a health organization deployment safeguard.
